comment: Routes for the route guide (docs/ROUTES.md). Steps: get/use an item (id from names.json; 'in' = room, when it matters), go to a room, end. The way between steps comes from the room files; hints say what the room data can't. Key-item order from the Jill Any% NMG split set (splits.json); use spots from the room files' use actions. Hints in our own words, only where certain (puzzles from the room scripts, or a walkthrough's account matched to the room files); 'done' = the story flag set once a step has happened (flag-labels.json). Unverified until followed through a whole run.

routes.name: Jill Any% NMG
routes.source: Draft (2026-10-27): the key-item order of the Jill Any% NMG split set, the use spots and flags from the room files, and the events and puzzles a full-game walkthrough describes (each matched to the room files); not yet followed through a run

steps.hint: On the wall above the dining room's fireplace.
The game won't let you leave yet: check the corridor past the dining room (Kenneth), and wait for the zombie to get up.
Run back to the dining room: Barry shoots the zombie.
Back to the main hall: Wesker is missing.
Look for Wesker upstairs, then come back down the stairs.
Barry hands you the lockpick in the main hall.
Push the statue along the balcony and off the edge where the railing is gone: it drops the Blue Jewel into the dining room for later.
Pour it into the water pump by the windows: the vines die.
Past where the vines were.
Push the shelf beside the piano aside: the sheet music is behind it.
Play the piano: a wall opens.
In the room behind the wall.
Put the Emblem where the Gold Emblem was, so the way stays open.
Put it above the dining room's fireplace: the clock moves.
In the statue's pieces on the dining room floor.
Behind the clock.
Put the Blue Jewel in the tiger statue's eye.
Richard is here, poisoned; he asks for the serum.
On the shelf in the item box room, once you've found Richard.
Take it back to Richard.
Yawn's attic, through the Shield key door: grab the crest and get out (fight Yawn or dodge it).
Push the two statues onto the grates in the floor (before the gas fills the room): the cabinet opens.
Push the switches under the paintings from youngest to oldest, then the one under the mourners; the Star crest appears there.
The four crests go in the door at the end of the back passage (any time you pass with one).
Push the stepladder until you can stand on its steps side, push it to the shelf, climb up.
Turn the crank at the post: the water drains. Cross the pool and take the lift down.
Push the statue in the entrance hall east, then south over the hole in the floor.
On the bed in room 001.
Drain the bathtub: the key is at the bottom.
Grab the key and run straight back out: the bees.
Push the boxes into the water to make a bridge: round the corner, along the hall, the one nearest the water in first.
Use the panel and pull the lever; press the flashing button on your way out.
The sparkle on the right-hand shelf.
Put the Red Book in the gap on the bookshelf: the way to Plant 42 opens.
Beat Plant 42, then check the fireplace.
On the shelf in the study off the back passage (Helmet key door).
Through the Helmet key door: check the piano (Yawn again), then the hole. For the fastest ending don't wait for Barry: climb down and go on.
On the chair in the closet, up the lift from the kitchen.
Put the battery in the slot by the lift at the falls.
Turn the crank again: the water comes back and the waterfall stops. Then the lift in the alley, and the ladder between the pools.
Down the ladder between the pools at the falls.
After Enrico's scene: the sparkle back down the hall.
In the little hole near the pit.
Black Tiger: then cut the web on the door with the knife (or burn it).
Turn the crank in the hole in the wall three times; let the boulder chase you into the new gap.
Push the statue toward the door five times, turn the crank in the hole twice, then push the statue onto the tile.
In the cabinet.
Open both Doom Books in your items (examine them and turn them): the Eagle and Wolf medals are inside.
The Wolf medal goes on the fountain's east side.
The Eagle medal goes on the west side; then down the fountain's steps to the lift.
At the computer: log in as JOHN, password ADA; B2's password is MOLE; then open B3.
Open the panel on the left wall and press the red button: the key is on the bookcase behind it.
Through the power maze: switch on the panel at the dead end, then activate the terminal by the machine.
After the Tyrant: pick up the key Wesker dropped.
On the floor of the emergency tunnel.
Put the battery back in the lift's slot.
In the red box on the right; use it to signal Brad.
